title: S1c ba-brief boundary manifest (elaborating-user-stories)
description: Boundary manifest for the S1 brief node (ba-research): the INDEX of the 3-level ref-chain pack (INDEX -> EPIC-* files -> STORY-* files). Permissive (additionalProperties:true) so the same artifact can also carry brief.json sections and the discovery/brief layer links. HYDRATION: consumers do not receive this manifest raw — engine/mapping.py _hydrate_ba_research dereferences epics[].file / story_files[].file into inline sidecar objects (shapes: elaborating-user-stories schemas/epic-sidecar.json + schemas/story-sidecar.json) and ADDS a `stories` key alongside the retained `story_files` refs. required mirrors the YAML required_fields.

audit_id.description: Producer-stamped deterministic provenance id (house formula ba-research:{idempotency_key}); same value in INDEX and the canonical brief; independent of the optional discovery input.

state.description: TL readiness signal; tl-design's pre-flight requires ready-for-tl.

discovery_file.description: Link to the discovery layer artifact produced by s1-discovery.

layers.description: Legacy four-layer pack map (discovery, brief, epics, stories). Retained for artifacts recorded before 2026-07-28; the current pack is INDEX -> epic sidecars -> story sidecars, with rules/domain/flows carried as refs.

human_view.description: Additive render-policy hint for the human-review layer; absence == default (generic tree).
